GEO-57-TC001 - Snapshot is created when analysis completes
steps: Given an analysis execution has just completed
When the results are finalized
Then the snapshot contains executedAt, totalQuestions, successCount, failedCount, and resolved config data

results.name: GEO-57-TC002 - Snapshot remains immutable
steps: Given a snapshot already exists
When an update to the snapshot is attempted
Then the snapshot remains unchanged

results.name: GEO-57-TC003 - Snapshot retention is preserved
steps: Given snapshots have been created over time
When the retention policy is checked
Then snapshots older than the retention window are not removed before 12 months

results.name: GEO-57-TC004 - Snapshot stores report and response links
steps: Given an analysis execution completes and snapshot storage runs
When the snapshot is created
Then snapshots are linked to reports, llm_responses reference snapshotId, and configSnapshot stores resolved competitors

results.name: GEO-55-TC001 - Guided tour starts from URL parameter
steps: Given a user opens the product with the tour URL parameter
When the tour activates
Then the tour navigates across Overview, Actions Center, and Category views with contextual tooltips

results.name: GEO-55-TC002 - Tour can be advanced or skipped
steps: Given a guided tour is currently active
When the user clicks advance or skip
Then the tour moves to the next step or ends cleanly

results.name: GEO-55-TC003 - Tour uses demo data and stays within step range
steps: Given no real report exists for the user
When the guided tour starts
Then the tour shows demo data and the total number of steps stays between 8 and 12

results.name: GEO-55-TC004 - Guided tour completion is tracked
steps: Given a guided tour is active and analytics tracking is enabled
When the user completes or skips the tour
Then tour completion analytics are recorded
